sentences.text:
Kishore Kumar Gupta vs The State Of West Bengal And Another
on 13 December, 2023
Author: Tirthankar Ghosh

Bench: Tirthankar Ghosh
 D/L319 C.R.R.4741 of 2023
13.12.2023
Bpg.
Kishore Kumar Gupta Versus The State of West Bengal and another Mr. Uay Sankar Chattopadhyay
Ms. Trisha Rakshit Ms. Rajashree Tah Ms. A. Datta.
...for the petitioner.
Mr. Anindya Sundar Chatterjee.
...for the State.
Petitioner is directed to serve a copy of the revisional application upon Mr. Anindya Sundar Chatterjee, learned advocate, who ordinarily appears on behalf of the State.
His appearance may be regularised by the concerned authorities.

Petitioner is also directed to serve a copy of the revisional application upon the opposite party no.2 by speed post with acknowledgement due and file affidavit-of-service on the next date fixed for hearing.

Although the subject matter of the case relates to offences under Sections 272/273 of the Indian Penal Code relating to seized Gur which has been alleged to be adulterated and the report of the food analyst is also available, Mr. Chatterjee, learned advocate appearing for petitioner presently is interested regarding the godown and not food items so concerned.

Mr. Anindya Sundar Chatterjee, learned advocate appearing for the State will submit a report before this Court as to how the godown may be handed over to the present petitioner and the steps be taken for disposal of seized Gur which according to the petitioner do not conform to the regulation of Food Safety and Standards.
Let such report be submitted on 5th January, 2024 when the matter would appear under the heading "To Be Mentioned".
All parties shall act on the server copy of this order duly downloaded from the official website of this Kishore Kumar Gupta vs The State Of West Bengal And Another on 13 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/84705076/
1 Court.
(Tirthankar Ghosh, J.)
